title: Frontend test harness and accessibility baseline
scope: Set up browser fixtures, role session mocks and viewport/keyboard test matrix for both frontends; prepare visual checks at 1440/1024/390px and capture screenshot baselines only after human acceptance

acceptance.text: Set up browser fixtures, role session mocks and viewport/keyboard test matrix for both frontends
Run one positive navigation test and one denied-access/keyboard test per portal
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a human-review PR
Follow docs/DESIGN_STANDARD.md; supply relevant viewport/state screenshots and keyboard/accessibility evidence for human visual review

verification: Run one positive navigation test and one denied-access/keyboard test per portal

evidence.text: Observed 2026-11-04: tests/frontend adds a Playwright harness for both frontends with one project per design-standard width (desktop-1440, tablet-1024, mobile-390), browser fixtures/servers on dedicated ports (fixture API :58092, built auditor via vite preview :58093, taxpayer Vite :58094), session mocks (support/sessions.ts: taxpayer personas taxpayer/guest/denied answering vati_tax.portal.api.* from backend portal fixtures; auditor personas officer/denied using the fixture API's own tenant scope), and a route/viewport/keyboard matrix (support/matrix.ts). Wired as npm run test:frontend:browser, typecheck:frontend-tests (in npm run check), lint/format globs and a frontend-browser CI job.

Observed 2026-11-04 on Windows 11 with Edge 156.0.4314.50 and Playwright 1.64.1, after merging main with TAX-029 and TAX-040: npm run test:frontend:browser gave 66 passed, 0 failed, 0 flaky (auditor 9/9 and taxpayer 13/13 at each of 1440/1024/390px; 9 opt-in visual tests skipped), summarised in docs/evidence/TAX-023/results.json. Per portal: one positive navigation test (auditor overview->queue->case->taxpayer profile->breadcrumb; taxpayer list->own submission->breadcrumb->new->account), denied-access tests (auditor: another tenant refused by the fixture API with no data shown; taxpayer: guest and non-taxpayer sent to login with a portal-only return path, another taxpayer's submission concealed as not found, revoked membership shows Access denied, logout then revisit goes to login) and keyboard tests (skip link, visible focus, navigation on Enter; taxpayer form focuses the first invalid field and keeps values).

Observed 2026-11-04: 41 screenshots in docs/evidence/TAX-023 captured from the running apps after the TAX-029 merge with CAPTURE_SCREENSHOTS=1 (auditor overview/queue/case/taxpayer/not-found/denied and taxpayer submissions/status/new/account/not-found/other-taxpayer/denied at 1440, 1024 and 390px, plus keyboard focus captures at 1440px). The axe scan (WCAG 2.0/2.1 A and AA, serious/critical) and reflow check (no page-wide horizontal scroll) pass on 6 auditor and 5 taxpayer routes at all widths, except one recorded defect excluded for that element only: label-content-name-mismatch on the auditor showcase loading-demo button (ShowcaseView.vue, auditor frontend owner). Screenshots are review evidence, not approved baselines; human visual review is still required.
